Ponlet Support

01

Contact support

For help or bug reports, email app-support@mat2uken.app.

Include your OS and Ponlet versions, the affected device, steps to reproduce, and the error shown. Limit screenshots to the relevant area and hide private information. Do not send passwords, invitation URLs or QR codes, transferred files, private message contents, or other confidential information.

02

First connection

  1. Open Ponlet on both devices. No dedicated accessory or Ponlet account is required.
  2. On one device, display the invitation QR code. On the other, choose the camera scan button and scan it. Alternatively, copy the invitation URL, paste it into the other device’s invitation URL field, and connect.
  3. Check that both devices show Connected. If the invitation expires, regenerate it and use the new QR code or URL. Share invitation details only with the intended recipient.
03

Files and messages

In the Transfer tab, choose a file to send. Check the completion status and the receiving device’s file list. In the Messages tab, enter text, send it, and check the other device’s message history.

On macOS, received files are normally saved automatically in Downloads/Ponlet under your home folder (Finder: Downloads → Ponlet). Use Open received folder or Copy save location to check the path. A numbered suffix is added when a file with the same name already exists. On iPhone, use the received file’s Share button and choose Save to Files.

04

Connection and camera help

  • If connection fails, check that both devices are online and the invitation has not expired. Network, VPN, or firewall restrictions can prevent a connection. Use a new invitation after a disconnection.
  • For QR scanning, adjust screen brightness and distance, and keep the entire code inside the camera frame.
  • If the camera view is black, close and reopen the scanner. If a screen display, mirroring, or recording tool is in use, temporarily close it and try again. Such tools are not necessarily the cause.
  • If camera access was not allowed, check Ponlet’s camera setting in the OS. You can use an invitation URL if you prefer not to change camera access.
  • If the issue continues, email the error and reproduction steps. Try a small test file first and keep your important originals.
05

Environment and privacy

The Apple apps target macOS 13 or later and iOS 17 or later. The locally verified combination uses a local validation build of Ponlet 1.0.18 on Mac and Ponlet 1.0.18 on iPhone Air running iOS 27.0.1. This does not establish compatibility with every device or network. The Ponlet Web app is also available.

See the Privacy Policy for data handling.
